Wolf bowed, murmured, "From behind a pine I step with a rustle and bow with measured courtesy. I hope I have not startled you, child. Tell me, which road leads to the place you walk toward with that basket that smells so sweet??"
Red startled, clutched, "Startled, I clutch the basket to my chest, and your courtesy warms me. I hurry to Grandmother's, down the safe path, to bring her food and comfort.."
Wolf prowled, whispered, "Along the edge of the path I pad, keeping to the shadows, feigning concern. Are you sure this path leads quickest to Grandmother's door??"
Red straightened, answered, "It's Grandmother's cottage, the one with blue shutters, just beyond the brook.."
Wolf purred, asked, "Grandmother, then. How far is she from here, child, and on a day like this, have you ever wished the walk might be shorter for an old woman waiting??"
